reason: I'd probably poke at the free hook scorer and trend tracking, but I'm not running deals through it. Brands already email me directly with no 10% cut, and I can't even keep up with those right now. A new marketplace full of small businesses doesn't get me anything I don't already have.
objection: At my size, small businesses booking off a menu are going to lowball me or want a $500 TikTok when my real rate is a few thousand. And with only a handful of brands on there, I'd be giving up 10% to get offers that are worse than what lands in my inbox.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real brands on there posting briefs with budgets that match my tier, $2K or more per post, so it brings me better deals than my inbox does and isn't just a payment layer.
